issue: The microSD socket J3 faces into the board. Its card opening points away from the edge, and R35-R39, C40 and C41 sit in the card's insertion path, so no card can be inserted.
evidence: J3 (Molex 104031-0811) is at (173,140), rotated 90 deg. In the stock footprint the card opening and the protrusion of the inserted card are on the local -y side, at the pin 1-8 row. The F.Fab card outline runs to y=-9.7, about 4 mm past the 11.4 mm body, and the silkscreen is open on that side. On the board this puts the opening at x~167.5, facing left, with the card reaching x~163.3. The socket rear (x~178.8) faces the right board edge at x=180. Parts in the card path: R35-R39 at x~163.1-163.6, y 134-144; C40 (0805) at (162.55-163.5,138); C41 at (164.94-165.42,139.96).

issue: The charger-to-battery path is a 0.15 mm trace for its whole length. It is far too narrow for the 1.5 A battery current and takes a detour.
The charger output narrows to 0.15-0.2 mm at both ends and changes layer through single small vias. The full 1.5 A system current goes through these sections.
evidence: U6 OUT pads 10/11 at (110.438,146.75)/(110.438,147.25) join through 0.15 mm traces to x=111.15, then the 0.15 mm segment (111.15,147.25)-(111.35,147.25), before widening to 0.5 mm. The path drops through one 0.6/0.3 mm via at (111.4,149.2) into the B.Cu pour (104.5-118.6, 129.9-154.2) and comes up through one 0.6/0.3 mm via at (109.5,133.05). U7 VIN pin 2 is fed by a 0.2 mm trace, (111.325,131.5)-(110.0,131.5).

issue: The SD bus takes long detours with many vias. SD_MISO loops back under the QSPI memory area, and the SD clock series resistor sits far from its source pin.
evidence: SD_MISO from U1.16 (127.2,140.45) to J3.7 is 64.6 mm routed against 40.5 mm straight, with 8 vias on the path (9 in the net): (125.50,140.04), (126.05,128.50), (128.50,128.35), (131.05,127.20), (132.95,129.10), (136.30,132.50), (136.84,135.08), (163.31,136.80). It loops up to y~127 under the flash/PSRAM area. SD_SCK_SRC from U1.14 (126.55,139.4) to R41 (140,135) is 20.2 mm routed with 3 vias, 14 mm straight. SD_SCK then runs another 32.7 mm with 2 vias to J3.5. The SD pins GPIO10-13 are on U1's left and bottom sides, and J3 is at the right edge.

issue: The QSPI traces are about twice their straight-line length and use 2-3 vias each. QSPI_D3 is daisy-chained, and FLASH_CS has a long branch to the BOOTSEL resistor and a long stub to its pull-up.
evidence: QSPI_D3: U1.55 to U2.7 is 24.1 mm against 11.2 mm straight, chained U1 -> PSRAM -> flash. QSPI_D1: U1.59 to U3.2 is 25.3 mm against 13.6 mm, 3 vias. QSPI_D2: U1.58 to U3.3 is 21.9 mm against 13.1 mm, 3 vias. FLASH_CS: U1.60 to U2.1 is 18.6 mm against 10.5 mm, 3 vias. Its branch to R11 (128.69,144.84) is 19.9 mm with 4 vias, 6 vias in the net. The R5 pull-up at (138.2,127) is an 11 mm stub from U2.3 (128.41,125.64).

issue: XIN detours through 2 vias and runs about 10 mm on the +3V3 plane layer. XOUT is routed directly.
evidence: XIN from U1.21 (129.2,140.45) to Y1.1 (121.9,142.85) is 13.7 mm routed against 7.7 mm straight. Vias at (129.29,139.11), inside the QFN outline, and (123.11,144.14), with about 10 mm on In2.Cu (+3V3 pour). XOUT is 5.6 mm on F.Cu with no vias.

issue: The USB input power path is routed at 0.15 mm and narrows to 0.1124 mm in places. It carries up to about 500 mA.
The PSRAM sits far from the RP2350's QSPI pins.
evidence: U3's center is 11.7 mm from the QSPI pins, and its signal pins are 9-14.6 mm from the matching U1 pins. For example, U3.1 to U1.2 is 14.6 mm and U3.2 to U1.59 is 13.6 mm.

issue: The BOOTSEL, RESET and ESP BOOT buttons are in the board interior instead of at an edge. SW1 and SW2 sit behind the J7 header.
evidence: SW1 BOOTSEL at (129,149) and SW2 RESET at (139.4,148) are about 16 mm from the bottom edge (y=165), behind J7. SW3 ESP BOOT at (151.7,128.4) is about 28 mm from the nearest edge.

issue: The battery connector is not at the board edge.
evidence: J2 (JST PH) at (109,139) is about 7 mm in from the left edge at x=100.

issue: The SWD connector is in the board interior.
evidence: J5 at (152,144) is about 21 mm from the bottom edge (y=165) and 28 mm from the right edge (x=180).
